name: Crimson Eclipse
body:
School evocation [blood]; Level antipaladin 2, bloodlord 2, cleric/oracle 2, death mage 2, inquisitor 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a vial of blood)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 20-ft.-radius emanation
Duration 2 hours/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You flood the area with a crimson shade like blood.

Within the area, all light spells are treated as 1 CL lower for their effects and duration and all blood and necromancy spells are considered 1 CL higher for their effects and duration.
